batches.title: Root TUI lifecycle, root mutation and diagnostic callbacks
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/ScreenStateGoldenTest.cpp and tests/tui/TuiTest.cpp replay the common-root add/remove/focus/input/clear/stop sequence and the regular renderer frames
batches.discriminatingCase: a stopped root that still paints, or a clear that leaves the deferred-wrap cursor, fails; the diagnostic-callback rows need a write-log capture so a callback that never runs separates from one that runs late
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture screen-state.json at 71023aec; tests/tui/ScreenStateGoldenTest.cpp already replays the historical bundle
batches.implementationObligation: Fake-cursor marker contract: C++ has no renderFakeCursor marker pair (CURSOR_MARKER, tui:fake-cursor-marker-constants, renderFakeCursor, tui:resolveFakeCursors) and keeps cursor positioning out of band; C++ overlay composition is not compared against TUI.showOverlay's cursor-preservation case
scenarioLabels: the public color query sets the palette only when all sixteen replies arrive

batches.title: Regular renderer, frame commit and render-state transfer
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/RenderDifferentialTest.cpp and tests/tui/TuiTest.cpp drive MainScreen render, invalidate and stop through a VirtualTerminal
batches.discriminatingCase: a regular frame that keeps the layout root attached after a fullscreen switch, or a render-state transfer that starts the new root, fails
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture renderer-switch.json; the product rows in B17 own the application-level switch
batches.implementationObligation: The same marker contract: TuiMainScreen.doRender has no fake-cursor resolution stage and no v1.3.0 comparison

batches.title: Alternate-screen viewport: frames, scroll algebra, scrollbar and search
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/ScrollViewEvidenceTest.cpp, tests/tui/ScrollbarEvidenceTest.cpp and tests/tui/AltScreenSearchTest.cpp replay the frozen scroll, scrollbar and search scenarios
batches.discriminatingCase: a followed window that stops following on append, a scrollbar reservation that changes the transcript width, or a search match painted without its highlight style, fails
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture the alt-screen families; #1035 owns the image placement-span frames inside the same viewport
batches.implementationObligation: The same marker contract for the alt-screen frame: TuiAltScreen.render draws the focused fake cursor as inline SGR

batches.title: Alternate-screen transcript selection, multi-click and copy
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/SelectionEvidenceTest.cpp replays the word/line cycle, wrapped-row geometry and the copy-on-select default
batches.discriminatingCase: a third click that selects a word instead of the line, a drag that keeps the double-click history after a reset, or a copy that returns the joined cell range instead of the frozen text, fails
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture selection.json; the styled CJK scenario is already registered and verified by this packet
batches.implementationObligation: C++ has no public resetTextSelection() combining the selection clear with the multi-click history reset; clear_text_selection() keeps the history and lastClick has no public reset

batches.title: Alternate-screen overlay, wheel and mouse routing
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/MouseRoutingTest.cpp, tests/tui/OverlayTest.cpp and tests/tui/MouseEvidenceTest.cpp replay the frozen wheel consumption, overlay hit testing and mouse capture rules
batches.discriminatingCase: a focused overlay that still forwards an unhandled wheel to the transcript (the recorded partial), or a wheel over an overlay that scrolls the transcript underneath, fails
batches.dependency: the C++ overlay wheel deferral is recorded partial in the ledger; a capture at pi-v1.3.0 plus the implementation fix is required before this batch can compare
batches.implementationObligation: C++ AltScreen still defers an unhandled wheel to the focused overlay (shouldDeferViewportInputToOverlay gates handleViewportInput) instead of scrolling the transcript

batches.title: Alternate-screen kitty image placement and eviction
batches.caller: cch::tui::AltScreen kitty placement lifecycle over a real terminal
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/AltScreenImageEvidenceTest.cpp replays crop/restore, anchor move, removal and eviction through VirtualTerminal
batches.discriminatingCase: an image re-emitted as a full transmission instead of a placement-only a=p command, or a session teardown that leaves the placement on screen, fails
batches.dependency: #1035 owns the placement-span repaint and its remaining emulator observation; #831 owns the dock footer frames

batches.title: Editor: layout, history, undo and kill/yank
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/EditorTest.cpp and tests/tui/EditorLayoutTest.cpp drive editing, wrapping, history, undo and the frozen word navigation
batches.discriminatingCase: an undo that leaves the cursor on the pre-edit column, a kill ring that yanks the wrong entry, or a wrapped click that maps to the previous grapheme, fails
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture editor-autocomplete.json and the screen-state editor scenarios; the fake-cursor rows stay with the cursor batch

batches.title: Terminal IO: process terminal, stdin framing, keys and keybindings
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/ProcessTerminalTest.cpp, tests/tui/StdinBufferTest.cpp and tests/tui/KeysTest.cpp replay the frozen startup, framing and key-identity observations
batches.discriminatingCase: a fragmented terminal reply that leaks into typed input, a Shift-modified symbol key that misses its produced character, or a keybinding context that converges on the wrong binding, fails
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture input.json and keys-kitty-text.json
batches.implementationObligation: C++ ProcessTerminal.stop() omits the frozen `ESC[>4;0m` modifyOtherKeys restore whenever modifyOtherKeys was never active, so the registered audit-1050 program-status-detection stop sequence is not reproduced byte for byte (#1182 finding); C++ parse_key/matches_key keep the explicit Shift flag on a produced symbol; StdinBuffer flushes a partial OSC/APC/kitty reply tail as typed input at the timeout; the remaining terminal families have no v1.3.0 comparison
scenarioLabels: E02 Kitty text vs shortcut identity; legacy/modifyOtherKeys/dup

batches.title: Image dimensions, protocol detection and the Image component
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/TerminalImageTest.cpp and tests/tui/ImageTest.cpp compare the protocol matrix, cell dimensions and the fallback rows
batches.discriminatingCase: a capability detected from the wrong environment variable, or a fallback row emitted after the image sequence, fails; the rendered placement needs a real emulator
batches.dependency: a frozen pi-v1.3.0 image dimension/protocol capture plus a real emulator observation; #1035 owns the placement-span repaint
batches.implementationObligation: C++ terminal image detection has no Herdr branch and no Herdr-before-Kitty ordering

batches.title: Autocomplete providers and fuzzy ranking
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/AutocompleteTest.cpp, tests/tui/AutocompleteRankingTest.cpp and tests/tui/FuzzyTest.cpp replay the frozen completion contexts, ranking and UTF-16 offsets
batches.discriminatingCase: a provider that completes at the wrong token boundary, or a fuzzy score that keeps the UTF-16 offset instead of the frozen UTF-8 one, fails
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture autocomplete.json and fuzzy.json

batches.title: Loader, mouse regions and residual small components
batches.caller: cch::tui::Loader/CancellableLoader, MouseRegion and the program-status helpers
batches.normalCase: tests/tui/LoaderTest.cpp and tests/tui/MouseRoutingTest.cpp replay the frozen spinner frames and mouse-region routing
batches.discriminatingCase: a loader that repaints only on the animation tick and misses a synchronous frame, or a mouse region that keeps routing after removal, fails
batches.dependency: frozen pi-v1.3.0 checkout with tsx to re-capture the loader and mouse-region scenarios

batches.title: Application product entries and the selected emulator scenarios
batches.caller: the ordinary application Session (coding_agent InteractiveMode) over a real terminal
batches.normalCase: tests/coding_agent/tui/NativeTuiDifferentialTest.cpp drives the dual-runtime scenario cells and tests/coding_agent/tui/ProductCursorEvidenceTest.cpp replays the frozen cursor frames
batches.discriminatingCase: a product row whose scenario is only observed by the external dual-runtime harness (skipped without the capture environment), or a row with no recorded comparison scenario at all (the #831/#1035 residuals), cannot be verified and must stay open
batches.dependency: #831 and #1035 own their exact remaining emulator scenarios; the native differential cells need the separately selected dual-runtime capture environment; the clipboard and hyperlink outcomes need a real emulator observation, not PTY bytes
batches.implementationObligation: The three scenario-less residual rows (hardware-cursor, residual-1035-image-placement, residual-831-dock-growth-footer) cannot carry a whole-row receipt until a comparison scenario is registered; program-status-protocol, transcript-selection-reset and wheel-over-overlay have no C++ implementation
scenarioLabels: extension editor installs, transfers text and focus, follows thinking and Bash borders, restores and reinstalls
